remedies.Qg_scope: VDS15V,ID16A,TA25C; LT gate can reach16V over SNS, hot/full-trajectory Qg is not bounded by this35nC value. Qgd and switching times are typical only.
remedies.limit_scope: LT steady test at VCC12V,OUT3..12V; not instantaneous or a guaranteed range at all actual source voltages. Resistor tolerance not included in these illustrative values.

remedies.arrangement: Precision trigger with inverted gate drive fires SCR across SAFE5 after U4; existing U5/U4 interrupt persistent high pre-rail. Gate driver/pulse/holdoff not qualified and not captured.
remedies.reference_scope: VKA=Vref,IKA10mA test, not every open-loop comparator/gate-driver bias. Iref25Cmax4uA plus full-temp deviation2.5uA used conservatively. Cathode-voltage/reference dependence and driver error add further requirements; not guaranteed application trips.
